snippet.title: Simple 2000 Series Vol. 116: The Nekomura no Hitobito
snippet.description: Or, The Residents of Cat Village. Here's the gameplay-sequel to the excellent The Genshijin.  Lead your army of very Japanese cats against the corrupt Magistrate Pug and rescue Nekohime.
